newsitem.title: USA: CSX pact to boost Conrail price - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: CSX pact to boost Conrail price - WSJ.

text.p: CSX Corp and Conrail Inc are close to a pact that would boost the price for Conrail by $1 billion to $10.5 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported in its Monday electronic edition.
The report said the deal would give Conrail shareholders $115 a share, double the price of the stock on the day the proposed merger of Conrail and CSX was announced.
The report said the pact, which is to be reviewed by Conrail's board today, calls for Norfolk Southern to buy almost half of Conrail's routes.

As reported over the weekend, the paper said the deal would allow CSX and Norfolk to each keep one of Conrail's major routes into New York. It said the plan would give Norfolk, which operates primarily in the Midwest and Southeast, access to the East with a route through Pittsburgh and Harrisburg, Pennsylvania.
